title: chamaeriphes thebaica
intro: Chamaeriphes thebaica, commonly known as Egyptian chamomile, is a flowering plant native to Egypt. It is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, offering various health benefits such as calming the nervous system, reducing anxiety and insomnia, and alleviating symptoms of menstrual cramps and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Egyptian chamomile, including apigenin, luteolin, and bisabolol, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antispasmodic effects. The plant's soothing properties and bioactive compounds have made it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine and herbal remedies.
